case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your alternative proposals; we are certainly open to a 24-month contract to ensure stability for both of us. However, your suggested prices do not reflect the reality of our current cost structure, particularly with recent wage increases. Our foundry prides itself on delivering dependable quality, and we deeply value the long relationship between our companies. To maintain this high standard together, we can offer €51.30 per unit for a 24-month term with our standard 30-day payment terms.

To summarize our current offer in full, we propose a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our current offer stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We appreciate your revised offer and are willing to meet you partway by shifting the effective date to 1 January 2027. In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we can offer €51.00 per unit for a 24-month contract with our standard 30-day payment terms.

As another option beside our current proposal, we can present an alternative package with a price of €51.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €51.00 per unit. It is always a pleasure working with your team.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to move closer to a sustainable agreement. 

In response to your adjustment, we can offer a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. We are making this concession to honor our long-standing partnership, but we are nearing the limit of what is feasible for our foundry. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days. Our family foundry values the strong relationship we have built together over the years, and we trust this adjusted offer provides a solid path forward for both of our companies.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised offer; we appreciate your continued movement. As a family-run foundry with deep roots in our region, we truly value the decades of trust between Demo Gießerei GmbH and Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. 

In response, we can offer €50.50 per unit for the 24-month contract starting 1 April 2027 with 30-day payment terms. We are making this concession to honor our long-standing partnership, but we have now stretched as far as possible. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

To give you time for your internal review, please note that our Angebot stays valid for 7 days. Our proposed contract term of 24 months, starting from 1 April 2027, would secure our shared future at a price of €50.50 per unit with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net. 

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
